# Honesty Ledger

What is real, what is simplified, what is not built. Sourced from the code, the eval, and VERIFY-REPORT.md.

## Real
- **TabPFN verdict.** Every death/life verdict is a real TabPFN posterior over six modes from a 10-feature GitHub vector (`app/classifier.py`). Not a heuristic dressed up as a model.
- **Held-out eval.** 58.1% (TabPFN) vs 43.6% (1-NN) is leave-one-out over 117 hand-labelled repos, re-derivable from `scripts/eval_loo.py`. The earlier, better-looking in-distribution number was pulled because it did not survive a held-out test.
- **0G Compute narration.** The eulogy and tie-break adjudication run on deepseek-v4.1-flash via 0G Compute (`app/main.py`, `app/narrator.py`); the certificate badge is rendered from the real engine field, not hardcoded.
- **Grounding gate.** Generated prose is checked against the real README/commit record before it reaches the card; ungrounded output is refused and the cert falls back to a factual coroner (`app/narrator.py`, `tests/test_narration_grounding.py`).
- **Recovered last words.** The quotes (e.g. caprine's "Caprine is feature complete.") are lifted from the real repo and shown only when they pass the grounding check. bower's death note is empty because nothing defensible existed.
- **60+ tests green**, live app deployed and reachable (200).

## Simplified
- **Corpus is 117 rows, hand-labelled by me.** An honest held-out number, but not the universe of software.
- **`primary_language_freq` is full-corpus encoded**, not strictly per fold. Symmetric and conservative (removing it raises the baseline), so it does not inflate the win.
- **Cohort line** ("died like N of M similar repos") reuses the classifier's own neighbours. A UX touch, not an independent second opinion.
- **Cold latency.** An unseen repo means two live model calls plus a cold load (a couple of minutes); cached verdicts return under two seconds. The demo uses cached examples.

## Not built
- **No smart contracts / on-chain component.** Out of scope for this project.
- **Fully offline mode exists in code (local Ollama path) but the live demo does not run it** — 0G Compute is a network call. The post states this plainly; "open weights end to end" is true, "nothing phones home" is not claimed for the live service.
- **No DevRelay agent session** (optional challenge extra, skipped).
